learn.b: A parallelogram has 2 pairs of parallel sides. A rectangle has 4 right angles. A rhombus has 4 equal sides. A square is both, so every square is a rectangle.

1 foot = 12 inches. 1 gallon = 4 quarts. 1 pound = 16 ounces. To change to a smaller unit, multiply: 4 feet = 4 x 12 = 48 inches.

learn.b: The greatest common factor (GCF) is the biggest number that divides both numbers. Factors of 12: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12. Factors of 18: 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18. The GCF is 6.
The least common multiple (LCM) is the smallest number that is a multiple of both. Multiples of 4: 4, 8, 12. Multiples of 6: 6, 12. The LCM is 12.
Use the GCF to factor a sum: 12 + 18 = 6(2 + 3). Use the LCM for repeating events, like two buses that return together.

learn.b: Negative numbers are less than zero. The opposite of -8 is 8. Absolute value is the distance from 0, so |-12| = 12. On a number line, numbers to the right are greater: -7 < -3.
The x-axis and y-axis cross at (0, 0) and make 4 quadrants. (+,+) is I, (-,+) is II, (-,-) is III and (+,-) is IV.
Reflecting across the x-axis flips the sign of y: (2, 5) becomes (2, -5). Points with the same x are a distance |y1 - y2| apart.
